mentions.name: LLM-driven RPG
mentions.description: An RPG in development for 2026 whose differentiator is the proper use of LLMs in games—not lazy asset generation or logic coding, but AI used to make the game world actually feel alive. Built solo, with challenges being worked through as they come.
mentions.problem: Current LLM use in games is limited to lazy asset generation and logic coding, rather than making game worlds feel alive.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am devoting 2026 to focus on my rpg. The one differentiator here is something I am still not seeing: proper use of LLMs in games. The current batch is all lazy asset generation, maybe logic coding and what not, but not anything that could make the world actually feel alive.
